## Custom changes
- Resolved the official merge while preserving Custom Wire injection, billing, content moderation, model access, updater, payment, affiliate, and frontend behavior.
- Repaired the official GitHub release client injection to use the Custom updater client and regenerated `backend/cmd/server/wire_gen.go`.
- Fixed merge-introduced frontend type/identifier/i18n regressions in nullable `order_id`, `GroupsView.vue`, and model allowlist empty-selection messages.
- Reviewed all official/Custom overlaps and retained only thin bridges and registered Custom deltas.

## Database
- Official migrations reviewed: `238b_content_moderation_engine_meta.sql`, `239_channel_reasoning_effort_multipliers.sql`, and `240_affiliate_ledger_operation_id.sql`.
- Changes add `content_moderation_logs.engine_meta JSONB`, channel reasoning-effort multiplier JSONB with one-time compatibility backfill, and nullable `user_affiliate_ledger.operation_id VARCHAR(64)` with a unique partial index.
- Generated Ent/schema changes were checked against the exact Vendor v0.2.8 baseline. No Custom schema exception was introduced beyond the registered ledger entries.
- Production DDL/DML was not executed. Before rollout, inspect migration history and the three target columns/indexes with read-only SQL, then apply the repository migrations through the normal deployment path after backup approval.

## Validation
- `go generate ./cmd/server` passed.
- Backend targeted tests and `go test ./...` passed after Wire regeneration.
- Frontend typecheck, lint, Vitest (35 files, 231 tests), and production build passed.
- `upstream-shadow-map-test.sh` passed (176 mappings, 178 source paths).
- `custom-database-boundary-test.sh --mode final` passed with fingerprint `8282e352aae3e2e212bf4374bb80b92a277608fd3cdd3209bf1ef8cda3e094d4`.
- Candidate thin-bridge and delta ledgers were revalidated against Vendor v0.2.8 after pre-landing the exact contract budget updates.
- CI, `boundaries`, full backend build/unit/integration, full frontend validation, lint, and shell safety are required before merge; release publication and production instance acceptance remain separate gates.
